podcast.body: Their first single, released on Rainbow Records. It was not considered "especially good" and had a sound similar to Jean and Junis, with minimal distinctive guitar work, just "stabbing punctuation" and a "perfunctory solo." "Originally, they signed with the label called Rainbow Records, a medium-sized indie label in New York, where they put out their first single, I'm so glad."
